title: Market Raja MBBS
desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

title: Nalla Nilavulla Rathri
desc: Six friends on a business and pleasure trip to Shimoga see their night turn into a terrifying ordeal as unexpected violence and danger force them to fight for survival.

title: Rudrangi
desc: Bheem Rao Deshmukh, a tyrant who oppresses his people, is drawn to a beautiful woman named Rudrangi and desires physical contact with her. In order to satisfy his obsession, he terrorises her village.

title: Gumnaam
desc: An astute sub-inspector relentlessly pursues a malicious serial killer who victimises vulnerable adolescent girls. Therefore, this probe incurs severe consequences.

title: Game Changer
desc: A principled IAS officer battles systemic corruption, championing fair elections to uphold democratic integrity amidst political machinations.
